policy.relation_declarations: Relation/Declaration candidates are source-backed; derived declarations retain explicit source and derivation-link evidence.
policy.short_notation: Only an existing admitted alias is checked; no symbol is invented for a full named Relation.
policy.inverse: HAS_INVERSE is checked only for confirmed endpoint-reversing pairs; inverse permission/cardinality is not inferred.
policy.derived: Every Derived candidate requires IS_DERIVED_RELATION_OF in its formal declaration.
policy.legacy_formal_claims: Unlabelled and unrecognized Claim fences remain matrix rows and gaps.
